sources.title: Pogonatum aloides (Hedw.) P.Beauv.
sources.clean:
Lectotype (Newton in Spencer & al. in Taxon, in press): [icon] " Byssus tenerrima viridis, velutum referens " in Dillenius, Hist. Musc.: 7, t. 1, f. 14. 1741. - Voucher: Herb. Dillenius (OXF).

" Habitat in Terra. " RCN: 8401.

Note: According to Druce & Vines (Dill. Herb.: 215. 1907), voucher material in the Dillenian herbarium linked with the corresponding cited illustration is identifiable as the moss, Polytrichum aloides Hedw. (syn. Pogonatum aloides (Hedw.) P. Beauv.).

China, Nepal, Bhutan, India, Sri Lanka, Myanmar (Tan and lwatsuki 1993), Thailand, Vietnam, Philippines, Indonesia, Japan, Caucasus, North America, North and Central Africa (Wu and Jia 2004).

RECORDS. — Bescherelle (1882), Jelenc (1955 a): Alger; Bône; Djurjura; Édough. Litschauer (1904), Jelenc (1955 a): Fort National nach Michelet, 1000 - 1200 m. Jelenc (1951, 1967): Monts de Tlemcen, forêt de Zariffet au Koudiat d’Hafir, 1250 m. Jelenc (1955 a): Atlas de Blida; Kabylie du Djurdjura, Akfadou; Kabylie du Djurdjura, Tifrit; Kabylie du Djurdjura, Tirourda. Jelenc (1956, 1967): Kabylie du Djurdjura, massif de l’Akfadou, fontaine des Ifs, 1200 m; Maison forestière de l’Agoulmine Aberkane. Frequent.
